title: Pin apt to a dated Ubuntu archive snapshot
author: anton-matosov
body:
Apt packages floated within the Ubuntu release. With the registry build cache (#70), a cached build quietly keeps whatever versions it last saw, and an uncached one gives new digests every time, so no build could be shown to be unchanged. This pins them, as ADR 0022 "All inputs are pinned", which replaces the apt exception in ADR 0013 and the README.

## What changes

- The core image writes `APT::Snapshot "<UBUNTU_SNAPSHOT_VERSION>"` into apt's config, so every `apt-get update`, there and in the child images, reads the same dated snapshot from `snapshot.ubuntu.com`. The image keeps it, so `apt-get install` in a CI job gets that day's versions too (noted in `docs/usage/core.md`).
- The base image has no CA certificates, so the first update and install skip the TLS peer check for the snapshot host. apt still checks the archive's signatures and hashes. Later updates check TLS normally.
- Every `apt-get update` has `--error-on=any`. Without it, apt ignores a failed index download and installs from stale lists.
- Docker's apt repository has no snapshots, so `containerd.io` is pinned down to its package revision (`2.4.2-4`), like the other Docker packages.
- Renovate gets a custom `ubuntu-snapshot` datasource. The snapshot service lists no snapshots and accepts any timestamp, so the latest one is the day the `resolute-security` pocket last changed, read from its InRelease `Date:` line: at most one bump a day. It skips the release wait, since it carries security fixes (ADR 0019 updated).

## Test plan

Run locally on arm64, before rebasing onto #71 and #74 (they don't touch apt or Renovate):

- [x] `docker buildx bake --no-cache`: all four images build.
- [x] Core rebuilt again with `--no-cache`: `dpkg-query -W` gives the same 177 package versions both times.
- [x] Inside the image, `apt-cache policy` lists only `snapshot.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/20261121T000000Z` sources.
- [x] Smoke tests pass for core, coder-template and devcontainer-base.
- [ ] core-systemd smoke fails its last check locally ("the container exited with 0, not 130"). The published `edge` image from main fails the same way on that machine, so it comes from the machine; CI should confirm.
- [x] `renovate-config-validator` passes. A local Renovate lookup dry run with older pins proposes `20261101T000000Z` → `20261121T000000Z` and containerd.io `2.4.2-2` → `2.4.2-4`.
- [x] hadolint and actionlint clean.
- [ ] CI on both architectures.
